Import ChatGPT memory to Claude in 3 steps. Free, Pro, Max and Team plans.

1. Export - Ask ChatGPT to list its memories in one code block.
2. Start - Open Settings, then Memory, then Start import.
3. Paste - Paste the text and click Add to memory. Then review what Claude kept.

Needs: Free to Team
